findings.detail: Original amount, total change orders, revised amount, previous payment certificates, and final requested balance are present and agree. Invoice ISEW#5 is dated November 5, 2026, for $52,184.44, including CO#10 $3,356.40.

$468,842.25 is labeled previous payment certificates. There is no transaction-by-transaction paid/received ledger or bank evidence in pages 1-4. Page 4 additionally says this previous amount is unconditionally released.

No explicit credit reconciliation or affirmative zero-credit confirmation is shown. G702 deductions cells are blank. Page 2 names CO#10 and its total but provides no itemized supplier/subcontractor invoices or receipts for that change order. Full-package text search found no additional invoices.
Invoice expressly states TAX NOT INCLUDED while stating Total Due $52,184.44. Final tax treatment is not reconciled in pages 1-4.

Visually reads PERIOD TO: 9/22/27 and CONTRACT DATE: 10/27/2026. Period end is future-dated relative to the November 5, 2026 execution and November 17, 2026 cover. Contract date needs reconciliation with the executed agreement; original agreement was not part of this subtask.

Project is labeled iSmash: Seattle / Seattle WA, while the physical address is correctly stated as 607 SE Everett Mall Way, Suite 1, Everett WA 98208. Billing address is 1411 233rd Pl SE, Bothell WA 98021; its accuracy was not independently checked. Do not describe the physical job address as wrong.

G702 says Continuation Sheet, AIA Document G703, is attached. No actual G703 was identified in the cover inventory or searchable text of the 37-page package; the only G703 references are the standard references on page 3. Parent should cross-check other page review.

Contractor signature appears on By line; dated 11/5/2026. Notarial text, apparent notary signature and seal name Jeffrey Jordan Howe, Bucks County, Pennsylvania, commission expires September 30, 2027. Architect field is blank and no architect certification/signature is shown on this page. Authenticity and any contractual need for architect approval were not assessed.

G702 claims total completed/stored and earned $521,026.69, retainage $0 and balance to finish $0. These are Carney's certification figures and do not independently establish completion of outstanding checklist/warranty/HVAC issues.

Conditional waiver upon final payment is present, identifies Carney, Smash District LLC, Everett street address, $52,184.44 final payment, $521,026.69 total contract and $468,842.25 prior payments unconditionally released. Apparent signature over printed Michael Carney, President; dated November 5, 2026; notary signature/seal and November 5, 2026 acknowledgment present.

Waiver says it becomes effective upon receipt of a check and when the endorsed check is paid by the bank. It does not expressly mention ACH/wire. This is a literal wording observation, not a conclusion on enforceability.

Cover states all subcontractors have been reported paid in full by Carney. Page 4 certifies labor/laborers paid to its referred date. Neither is a detailed sub/supplier contract-total, paid-to-date and remaining-balance ledger. Other waiver pages are separately reviewed.

No separate explicit promise to deliver a new unconditional final release after cleared final payment is stated in pages 1-4. Current conditional release says it becomes unconditional when its payment condition is satisfied.

key_findings: The corrected packet contains an Onesta signed/notarized unconditional final-application waiver stating $433,979.97 on page 6, dated November 16, 2026. Page 5 is an earlier October 28 version without an Amount Paid value visible.
Page 23 adds Omni Mechanical Inc. signed/notarized unconditional final-application waiver stating $41,578.01, dated November 16, 2026.
27 historical progress-payment waiver forms, covering 10 named subcontractors, total $195,455.26. These are not 27 different subcontractors or 27 final releases.

26 of those progress forms are unconditional. Omni page 21 ($28,200.34, October 2 effective date) is conditional on actual receipt and clearance. The later November 16 Omni unconditional form states the cumulative $41,578.01 matching all three Omni progress amounts.

All 27 progress forms expressly exclude retention and items furnished after their stated effective date. Effective dates span April 6 to October 19, 2026. The packet print date October 19 is not the effective coverage date.

Nine named downstream parties have only progress forms in these pages. A complete project-wide party roster, current balances/retention ledger, and final-release arrangements cannot be verified from these waiver pages alone.
Do not add the newer Omni $41,578.01 to the $195,455.26 historical progress sum; it is cumulative overlap. Do not treat Onesta $433,979.97 and downstream waiver amounts as independent owner payments.
All pages 5–34 show signature marks. This audit confirms visible marks and stated signers/dates, not authenticity, signing authority, notarization validity or legal effect.
